definitionZh: CSS 的短手属性设置了在绘制元素内容时使用的最大列数,以及元素列的最小宽度和最大高度.
sourceDefinition: The columns CSS shorthand property sets the maximum number of columns to use when drawing an element's contents, along with the minimum width and maximum height of the element's columns.
